Thanks for looping us in. A few legal intake items so we can hit your dates without surprises:

- Please send the SOW (even as a short statement of work) and any DPA language you require. If you have a security questionnaire, share that as well — we can provide SOC 2 report and our standard DPA.
- Our redline process: we will perform an initial pass on the first SOW/DPA within 3 business days and aim to consolidate comments in a single marked-up document. If there are non-standard terms (data residency, indemnity caps, audited by HSM/KMS), flag them up front so we can escalate.
- Milestone expectations: to align, please note that our legal needs a finalized SOW + security questionnaire to meet the Apr 22 procurement review date. If any items slip beyond that, PO timing will likely slide accordingly.

Attachment: standard_sow_template.docx

I'll be the Redwood lead for redlines. For execution and DocuSign routing, Rishi will handle signatory flow.
